theater: 波美拉尼亞與波羅的海西岸

battle.name: 法瑞戰爭
battle.theater: 波美拉尼亞與波羅的海西岸
battle.brief: 一八〇五年四月瑞典同英國簽訂同盟、加入第三次反法同盟，法國隨後宣戰；大軍自漢諾威北上入波美拉尼亞，一八〇六年五月包圍斯特拉爾松，守軍在莫爾納伯爵率領下投降。卡牌這柄輪發槍已退居軍官與近衛的配槍，只在騎兵貼身纏鬥時補上一發。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 交戰的兩方是法蘭西第一帝國與瑞典王國，但戰爭自一開始就是整個北方體系的一環。法國一方由拿破崙一世直接統帥：貝內迪克特第八軍團自漢諾威向波美拉尼亞推進，莫爾蒂埃第五軍團、內伊第六軍團同德辛的一支軍團在後跟進，另有帝國近衛軍與直屬砲兵，格里博瓦爾制式野戰砲同攻城砲由工兵連同浮橋器材一同前進；海上有維拉雷-茹埃斯率領的分艦隊，企圖以波美拉尼亞的港口逼近英國海岸。瑞典一方由國王古斯塔夫四世·阿道夫主持，軍隊以本土步兵營、王家騎兵同王家近衛為骨幹，波美拉尼亞守軍由莫爾納伯爵指揮，守的是以德語為主的當地營伍同少量援兵。戰場周圍還有四股力量：英國以皇家海軍封鎖，並於一八〇八年派穆爾率遠征軍赴瑞典；俄國趁機向芬蘭用兵，終於迫使瑞典割地；丹麥-挪威於一八〇七年被迫加入封鎖體系，一八〇八年由海上攻入瑞典南部；普魯士起初中立，一八〇五年被迫封鎖波美拉尼亞港口，不准英國船隻接應，翌年才加入聯盟。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the French Empire and the Kingdom of Sweden, but the war was from the outset one part of a much larger northern system. On the French side the command was Napoleon's own: Bernadotte's VIII Corps pushed forward from Hanover into Pomerania, with Mortier's V Corps, Ney's VI Corps and a corps under Dessin following, together with the Imperial Guard and the army artillery, the Gribeauval field and siege guns moving forward with the engineers and their pontoon equipment; at sea a squadron under Villaret-Joyeuse sought to work up from the Pomeranian ports towards the British coast. On the Swedish side the leading figure was King Gustav IV Adolf, and the army rested on native infantry regiments, the royal cavalry and the royal household troops, while the garrison of Pomerania was commanded by Count Mörner and consisted mainly of locally recruited German-speaking companies with a small number of reinforcements. Four further powers pressed on the edges of the theatre: Britain, whose Royal Navy blockaded and who sent an expedition under Moore to Sweden in 1808; Russia, which took advantage of the moment to campaign in Finland and ultimately forced the cession of territory; Denmark and Norway, pushed into the Continental System in 1807 and invading southern Sweden from the sea in 1808; and Prussia, at first neutral and forced in 1805 to close the Pomeranian ports to British contact, which only joined the coalition the following year.
people: 瑞典方面的核心是國王古斯塔夫四世·阿道夫，他是虔誠的反法同盟支持者，一八〇五年四月同英國簽訂同盟之後，法國隨即視瑞典為敵國；他本想守住波美拉尼亞，於一八〇六年失去斯特拉爾松，一八〇九年又被迫交出芬蘭，同年更失去王位，由其子卡爾十三世接任。波美拉尼亞總督莫爾納伯爵守斯特拉爾松到最後，一八〇六年五月城陷時率殘部投降，此後被押往法國，其後再奉命率領瑞典援軍赴德國作戰。法軍方面，貝內迪克特自一八〇五年率第八軍團打頭陣、指揮包圍斯特拉爾松，一八〇九年更接手由拿破崙編成的瑞典軍團，日後成為瑞典王儲兼法國元帥——這個反轉是這場戰爭最耐人尋味的一段。英國方面，赴瑞典的遠征軍由穆爾率領，海上有皇家海軍掩護；丹麥-挪威由王儲腓特烈（後來的腓特烈六世）主持北方戰線，一八〇九年一度圍困馬爾默；俄國在芬蘭戰役中指揮入侵的是布加喬夫。各方將領的名字在維基戰爭列表行內並無記載，以上是靠通史與各語條目補充，個別稱謂在不同文獻裡寫法不同。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Swedish side was King Gustav IV Adolf, a sincere supporter of the anti-French coalition; after signing an alliance with Britain in April 1805 France at once treated Sweden as an enemy. He meant to hold Pomerania, lost Stralsund in 1806, was forced to give up Finland in 1809 and in the same year lost his throne, his son Charles XIII succeeding him. Count Mörner, governor of Pomerania, held Stralsund to the end and surrendered with the remnant of his garrison when the place fell in May 1806; he was afterwards taken to France and later led a Swedish reinforcement corps to Germany. On the French side Bernadotte led the VIII Corps from the first advance of 1805 and directed the siege of Stralsund, and in 1809 took over the Swedish Legion formed by Napoleon, later becoming crown prince of Sweden and a marshal of France — the most striking reversal in the whole war. On the British side the expedition to Sweden was led by Moore under the cover of the Royal Navy; Denmark and Norway were led on their northern front by the crown prince, the future Frederick VI, who invested Malmö in 1809; and the Russian invasion of Finland was commanded by Bagration. The names of these commanders do not appear in the row of the Wikipedia war list, so the identifications above are drawn from general histories and from the articles in the several languages, and some of the titles are written differently in different sources.
kits: 卡牌上的兵器是輪發槍，即十五世紀末西班牙出現的最早可重複發射後膛手槍，靠擊錘摩擦黃鐵礦片取火，每擊一次只成一發，機件要隨身攜帶並在每次射擊前旋緊發條，射速極慢而造價高昂。一八〇五年的北歐戰線上，這種槍早就退到軍官、王室近衛同衛兵的腰間，屬於身份標誌加備用兵器：瑞典王家近衛同部分近衛騎兵仍配輪發槍，法國帝國近衛軍老近衛的近衛騎兵亦然，兩邊的用法幾乎一樣——騎兵衝鋒之後，貼身纏鬥那幾秒才開一發。真正決定波美拉尼亞戰線的是另一批裝備：法軍步兵用共和曆第十一年式（即一八〇一年式）燧發滑膛槍配刺刀，瑞典步兵仍然是十八世紀末式燧發滑膛槍配刺刀，已無火繩槍；砲兵方面法軍用格里博瓦爾制式四磅、八磅同十二磅野戰砲，圍攻斯特拉爾松再加重型攻城砲，瑞典守軍只有少量野砲同守城重砲可用。攻城器材方面，法軍靠攻城砲、壕溝同坑道，北方土壤凍結令掘壕極難。運輸同補給更加吃緊：波美拉尼亞多石鋪鄉道，泥濘同積雪拖慢運貨車隊，重砲同彈藥車每門要六至八匹馬；海運亦受英國封鎖同波羅的海冬季風浪限制，糧食同彈藥多靠冬季前的海路一次過運上。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the wheellock pistol, the earliest repeating rear-loading handgun, which appeared in Spain in the late fifteenth century. It fired by letting a hammer strike a piece of pyrite, produced one shot for each pull of the trigger, and the mechanism had to be carried on the person with its spring wound before every shot, so its rate of fire was very slow and its cost very high. On the northern fronts of 1805 the weapon had long since retreated to the belts of officers, household troops and guards, where it served as a mark of rank and a backup arm: the Swedish royal household and parts of their mounted guards still carried wheellock pistols, and so did the carabiniers of the French Imperial Guard's Old Guard, and the two used them in much the same way — after the charge, one shot fired at the last, in the seconds of close combat. What actually decided the Pomeranian theatre was a different set of weapons: French infantry carried flintlock smoothbore muskets with bayonets, the An XI pattern, that is the model of 1801; Swedish infantry still used late eighteenth century flintlock smoothbores with bayonets and had no matchlocks left at all. In the artillery, the French used the Gribeauval system field guns of four, eight and twelve pounds, and added heavy siege guns for the investment of Stralsund, while the Swedish had only a few field guns and the fortress pieces to work with. For the siege the French brought heavy guns, trenches and saps, and the frozen northern ground made digging extremely hard. Transport and supply were worse: the Pomeranian roads were paved German country roads, and mud and snow slowed the wagon trains, while every heavy gun and its ammunition wagon needed six to eight horses; the sea route too was constrained by the British blockade and by winter gales in the Baltic, so food and ammunition had to be moved up in bulk before the winter.
tactics: 波美拉尼亞戰線的特色是追擊、封鎖同攻城三者一起來。一八〇五年十月，法軍放棄在漢諾威同奧得河下游的縱隊推進，改為以輕裝縱隊沿石鋪鄉道快速北上，令瑞典陸軍不能夠集中兵力；海上有法國分艦隊企圖由波美拉尼亞港口出擊英國海岸，令英國必須分兵應付。真正的攻城是斯特拉爾松：一八〇六年春，法軍以兩路縱隊同時逼近要塞，先用野戰砲同攻城砲封鎖要塞外圍，剪斷守軍同波美拉尼亞內陸的聯絡，再以壕溝圍城，最後守軍在五月投降。守方靠城牆射界同堡壘射線拖延，法軍火炮設在高地展開；守軍不斷出擊騷擾圍城線，但兵力不足以反攻。北方其他戰線上，瑞典以縱隊加民兵守衛鄉村同據點，丹麥-挪威靠海軍登陸同沿岸封鎖，令瑞典南部一直失血；一八〇九年丹麥兵圍馬爾默，最後由英瑞聯合部隊解圍。俄國在芬蘭的做法完全相反：靠冬季嚴寒，沿雪路長驅直入，逼近首都。
tacticsEn: The Pomeranian front combined three things at once: pursuit, blockade and siege. In October 1805 the French gave up marching in column along the Elbe and the lower Oder and switched to light columns moving quickly north along the paved country roads, so that the Swedish army could never concentrate its forces; at sea the French squadron tried to work out of the Pomeranian ports against the British coast, obliging Britain to divide her attention. The real siege was Stralsund: in the spring of 1806 the French closed on the fortress with two columns at once, first blanketing it with field and heavy siege guns, cutting the garrison off from the interior of Pomerania, and then completing the investment with trenches, until the garrison surrendered in May. The defence relied on the fire of the walls and the ranges of the works to hold the attackers off, the French guns being deployed on the heights; the garrison sortie again and again to harass the lines of investment, but it never had the strength to attack in earnest. On the other northern fronts the Swedish defended villages and strongpoints with columns and militia, while Denmark and Norway worked by landing from the sea and blockading the coast, so that southern Sweden was bled continuously; in 1809 the Danish troops invested Malmö and were finally relieved by a combined Anglo-Swedish force. The Russian method in Finland was the opposite: hard winter, advance along the snow roads, and the enemy driven up against his own capital.
data: 可核對的數字集中在斯特拉爾松同一八〇九年。斯特拉爾松：法軍包圍軍一般記為一萬人上下（有說近一萬二千），瑞典守軍約三千至四千五百人；城陷在一八〇六年五月下旬，守軍由莫爾納伯爵率領投降，約一千二百人被押往法國，其餘獲准返國。時間線：瑞典同英國的同盟條約在一八〇五年四月，法國正式宣戰在同年八月；法軍入波美拉尼亞在同年十月；斯特拉爾松陷落在翌年五月；一八〇七年丹麥-挪威被迫加入封鎖體系；一八〇八年北方三條戰線同時開打——俄國攻芬蘭、丹麥-挪威攻瑞典南部、英國派遠征軍赴瑞典；一八〇九年三月俄軍進抵芬蘭南岸，亞波退離並遭焚燒，同年九月瑞典同俄國議和割讓芬蘭；一八〇九年英瑞聯軍解馬爾默之圍。距離同補給：自漢諾威到斯特拉爾松約四百公里，波美拉尼亞的森林泥路令日行軍常不足二十公里；由波美拉尼亞到斯德哥爾摩海路約六百公里。戰俘方面，瑞典另有一批軍官長期扣在法國，數目以數十計；一八〇九年和約的賠款以銀貨支付，各書記載出入頗大，不宜引用單一數目。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster around Stralsund and the year 1809. Stralsund: the besieging French force is generally given as about ten thousand men, in some accounts close to twelve thousand, against a Swedish garrison of roughly three to four and a half thousand; the place fell in the latter part of May 1806, the garrison surrendering under Count Mörner, about twelve hundred men being sent to France and the rest being allowed to return. The chronology: the Swedish alliance treaty with Britain was signed in April 1805, France declared war in August of the same year, the French entered Pomerania that October, and Stralsund fell the following May; Denmark and Norway were forced into the Continental System in 1807; in 1808 three northern fronts opened at once — Russia invaded Finland, Denmark and Norway attacked southern Sweden from the sea, and Britain sent an expedition to Sweden; in March 1809 the Russians reached the southern coast of Finland and Åbo was evacuated and burned, and in September that year Sweden made peace with Russia and ceded Finland; in 1809 a combined Anglo-Swedish force relieved Malmö. In distance and supply: from Hanover to Stralsund is about four hundred kilometres, and the forest roads and mud of Pomerania kept the daily march under twenty kilometres; by sea from Pomerania to Stockholm is some six hundred kilometres. On prisoners: a number of Swedish officers were held in France for a long time, counted in tens rather than hundreds; the silver paid under the 1809 treaty differs considerably from source to source, so no single figure should be quoted.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一層是拿破崙的北方計劃：法國要封鎖英國、掃蕩英國的北方航線，也要波美拉尼亞的造船木材同瑞典的鐵，只要瑞典站在英國一邊，北方的仗就一定要打。第二層是瑞典自己的選擇：國王古斯塔夫四世虔誠反法，一八〇五年四月同英國簽訂同盟、加入第三次反法同盟，法國隨即視瑞典為敵國，宣戰也是必然；而波美拉尼亞當地以德語為主的居民同普魯士中立，令法軍越境不單是對瑞典開戰，還要迫普魯士就範——普魯士要封鎖波美拉尼亞港口，不准英國船隻接應，這個動作本身已令普魯士記恨。第三層是戰爭一旦開了就停不了：一八〇七年丹麥-挪威被迫加入封鎖體系，一八〇八年俄國趁北方虛空用兵、丹麥-挪威又由南面進攻，瑞典前後受敵；法國更要求瑞典海軍交出戰列艦供北方分艦隊使用，衝突愈演愈烈。史家亦指出，瑞典朝野對「參戰抑或繼續中立」本有分歧，國王一意孤行，這個取捨最終令瑞典失地。
causeEn: The war has three layers of cause. The first is Napoleon's northern plan: France needed to blockade Britain and sweep up Britain's northern sea routes, and it wanted the shipbuilding timber of Pomerania and the iron of Sweden, so as long as Sweden stood on Britain's side the war in the north had to be fought. The second is Sweden's own choice: King Gustav IV Adolf was a sincere opponent of France, and once he had signed the alliance with Britain in April 1805 and joined the Third Coalition France inevitably came to treat Sweden as an enemy and declare war; and because the population of Pomerania was largely German-speaking while Prussia insisted on neutrality, a French march across the country was not only war against Sweden but also a coercion of Prussia — Prussia had to close the Pomeranian ports to British contact, and resented it. The third is that once the war had begun it could not be stopped: Denmark and Norway were forced into the Continental System in 1807, in 1808 Russia took advantage of the emptiness in the north and Denmark and Norway attacked from the south, so that Sweden was beset on both sides; and France demanded that the Swedish navy hand over ships of the line for the northern squadron, which made the quarrel worse. Historians also note that Swedish opinion itself was divided over whether to go to war or remain neutral, and that the king had his way; the choice is what cost Sweden its territory.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果對三方都是重的。瑞典失去波美拉尼亞：一八〇七年霍爾施泰因公爵把該地交給拿破崙作軍區，瑞典在本土以外的戰略根據地消失，軍隊同物資從此要經波羅的海迂迴調動；一八〇九年再被迫割讓芬蘭，芬蘭居民以瑞典語為多數，割地直接動搖王國的合法性，同年古斯塔夫四世被廢黜，兒子卡爾十三世繼位。一八〇九年十二月瑞典被迫加入封鎖體系並提供軍團（由貝內迪克特率領），國家機器被拿破崙的體系完全吸收。丹麥-挪威方面，一八一四年基爾和約交出挪威，瑞典-挪威聯邦成立，挪威人的抵抗成為丹麥-挪威王國長期的痛。俄國得到芬蘭，芬蘭大公國建立，彼得堡南方多了一個省同一個海軍基地，這是日後芬蘭問題同維也納體系的伏線。對全歐洲而言，一八〇六年斯特拉爾松投降之後，拿破崙多了一條北方前線，這條前線之後沒有再消耗過瑞典兵力；真正攤牌要等一八一三年，北方同盟重新組合，戰果歸零。
impactEn: The consequences of the war were heavy for all three parties. Sweden lost Pomerania: in 1807 the Duke of Holstein handed that territory over to Napoleon as a military district, the country's strategic base outside its own soil disappeared, and troops and stores thereafter had to be moved round by sea through the Baltic; in 1809 it was forced to cede Finland, whose inhabitants were Swedish-speaking in the majority, and the cession struck directly at the legitimacy of the kingdom, Gustav IV Adolf being deposed in the same year and replaced by his son Charles XIII. In December 1809 Sweden was compelled to join the Continental System and to furnish a corps under Bernadotte, and the state machine was absorbed entirely into Napoleon's system. For Denmark and Norway, the Treaty of Kiel of 1814 surrendered Norway and established the union of Sweden and Norway, and Norwegian resistance became a standing grievance of the Danish-Norwegian crown. Russia gained Finland and created the Grand Duchy of Finland, adding a province and a naval base to the south of Petersburg, which was the seed of the Finnish question and of the Vienna settlement. For Europe as a whole, after the fall of Stralsund in 1806 Napoleon possessed a northern front that from then on never cost Sweden another soldier; the real reckoning came in 1813, when the northern alliance was reconstituted and the results of the war were wiped out.
result: 結果是法國在北方贏得乾乾淨脆，瑞典輸到連王位都保不住。斯特拉爾松一八〇六年五月陷落，波美拉尼亞的要塞同港口全部落入法軍之手，瑞典在德國境內的陸軍同海軍同時失去立足點；一八〇七年霍爾施泰因公爵再把波美拉尼亞交給法國，瑞典被逐出北方。俄國在同一場戰爭中贏走芬蘭，丹麥-挪威贏回一陣，一八一四年基爾和約又交出挪威。一八〇九年之後，法瑞之間再沒有大規模會戰，只餘零星騷擾同封鎖摩擦，池內一般記到一八一〇年為止，各書收束日期不一；真正的了結在北方大反攻：一八一三年萊茵聯軍反攻，一八一四年基爾和約、一八一五年維也納會議將挪威同波美拉尼亞的命運交回瑞典手上，拿破崙在北方收了幾年的果實全部還了回去。落到兵器上，這場戰爭也是輪發槍告別的一場：這柄槍在波美拉尼亞的泥路同斯特拉爾松的城門前，只是在軍官同近衛腰間做最後一次身份證明；瑞典王室近衛換成燧發手槍那一年，國王也換了人——兵器同王權一起退場，只餘城牆上的砲管。
resultEn: The outcome was a clean French victory in the north and a Sweden that could not even keep its throne. Stralsund fell in May 1806, the fortresses and harbours of Pomerania went over to the French, and Sweden lost at one and the same time its footing for the army and the navy in German territory; in 1807 the Duke of Holstein handed Pomerania over to France and Sweden was pushed out of the north. Russia won Finland out of the same war, Denmark and Norway won for a while and then gave up Norway under the Treaty of Kiel in 1814. After 1809 there was no more large-scale battle between France and Sweden, only scattered harassment and the friction of the blockade, and the series is generally brought to a close at 1810, with the sources differing on the exact date; the real settlement came with the northern counter-offensive: the coalition of 1813 turned the front, the Treaty of Kiel of 1814 and the Congress of Vienna of 1815 handed Norway and the future of Pomerania back to Sweden, and everything Napoleon had gathered in the north was returned. As for arms, this war was also the farewell of the wheellock pistol: on the muddy roads of Pomerania and before the gates of Stralsund it did no more than serve as the last proof of identity at the belts of officers and guards; in the year when the Swedish royal household took to flintlock pistols the king had been exchanged as well — the weapon and the monarchy left the stage together, and only the gun barrels on the walls were left behind.
